agent_history_invariant.definition: Selected agent-history K/V must be an exact subset of cells already encoded in the session's live prefix cache.
required: multiple selected records in one attention normalization
request membership removal without deleting source membership
disallowed_as_agent_history_evidence: re-tokenizing selected records and prefilling them into a new cache
longest-common-prefix reuse of a changing composite selected-text resource
ordinary sequential state restore labeled as arbitrary selected K/V
fresh-prefill equivalence used as a substitute for same-state continuation

llama.cpp.previous_path: Selected record text was rendered into one composite resource; a changed suffix was re-prefilled.
llama.cpp.current_path: pra_source_slot plus pra_selected_ranges adds request sequence membership to existing unified-cache cells with llama_memory_seq_cp.
llama.cpp.kernel_constraint: The selected set must include the live prefix's last resident position so new positions remain consecutive.
remaining_gates: registered record lifecycle rather than client-trusted raw ranges
cancellation and concurrent commit conflict tests

HuggingFace.current_behavior: HuggingFaceEngineAdapter.add_reference encodes detached resource text independently of the agent's conversational past_key_values.
HuggingFace.required_repair: Capture per-record views/slices from the live past_key_values and consume selected views with explicit source cache_position semantics and one attention normalization.

MLX.current_behavior: The native executor tokenizes each resource, calls encode_native_memory, then concatenates selected K/V arrays.
MLX.required_repair: Snapshot immutable record views from the live prompt cache and use segmented selected attention without re-encoding or concatenating selected arrays.

vLLM.current_behavior: capture_paged_memory can read live prefill pages, but the active adapter does not bind stable agent records to scheduler-owned source pages; the hot bridge copies/rematerializes pages.
vLLM.required_repair: Pin source prefix blocks by session/record identity and build request block tables from selected existing block IDs, with copy and newly encoded token telemetry kept separate.

SGLang.current_behavior: The current executor tokenizes detached resource text and encodes it through an MLX-backed bridge; stock RadixAttention only reuses matching prefixes.
SGLang.required_repair: Bind record ranges to live RadixAttention cache nodes/pages and attach selected existing blocks to the request without resource-text encoding.

required_before_easy50: cache-on versus cache-off semantics reported without conflating fresh-prefill numerical reproducibility
